transport: gRPC over loopback HTTP/2, plaintext, protobuf envelope with Java DTO payload
execution: five Raft nodes in one JVM; per-node state directories and outgoing channels
workload: closed-loop PUT only; disjoint key ownership per sequential client
measured_client_channels: created at timed phase start; connection setup and client initialization included
latency_definition: client API call duration, including redirects/retries; timed phase only
throughput_denominator: measured monotonic elapsed time, including final in-flight completion
failure_method: explicit server.stop/node.stop in one JVM; not an OS process kill or power loss
failover_measurement: from stop invocation through first confirmed PUT via newly discovered leader; polling every 20ms
